systems.owner: National ID Program, operationalised as the state-owned enterprise FaydaVerse; project implementing agency the Prime Minister's Office; World Bank financed (P179040)
systems.tiers: national; 39,028,382 people with a Fayda ID at 23 March 2026; permanent, semi-permanent and mobile registration sites
12 government agencies integrated at 23 March 2026; the report does not say whether the civil registrar is one of them

note: A World Bank status report on the digital ID project; it reports identity enrolment and authentication only and states nothing about civil registration. Its 'mobile registration' sites are Fayda enrolment sites.
